objective: Retain every public-safe professional evidence fragment while recursively developing the strongest defensible claims, preserving uncertainty and collective credit, and projecting only what the current public argument needs.

hardGates.passCondition: Every supplied public-safe fragment has an intake record or an opaque protected locator and a next action.
failureExamples: A supplied article remains only in chat history
A memory is omitted because it is not yet proven

hardGates.passCondition: Every used source states what it supports, what it does not establish, its provenance, and its preservation posture.
failureExamples: A URL is treated as a seal of authority
A project website is treated as independent proof of impact

hardGates.passCondition: Sources, evidence relationships, claim propositions, memories, and projections remain distinct graph objects.
failureExamples: A memory becomes a confirmed claim without evidence
An article title is copied directly into public positioning

hardGates.passCondition: Confirmed, bounded, inferred, open, not-recovered, held, and disallowed states match the available evidence.
failureExamples: Not recovered becomes did not exist
A bounded direct action is left timidly unclaimed

hardGates.passCondition: Jamie receives direct credit for supported actions while collective campaigns, legislation, and institutional outcomes remain collective.
failureExamples: Jamie single-handedly repealed the Cabaret Law
Jamie's direct testimony disappears into vague team language

hardGates.passCondition: Claim maturity and public-site selection are separate; only claims selected for a named surface become active projections.
failureExamples: Every confirmed claim is added to the homepage
A pending role hypothesis appears on the resume

hardGates.passCondition: Consequential active public claims resolve to stable claim and source IDs without requiring citation markers to dominate the interface.
failureExamples: A site claim has no source path

hardGates.passCondition: The public repository contains no private paths, raw private materials, unapproved identities, credentials, or unsafe archive detail.
failureExamples: A local photo path is committed
A private memory is quoted instead of summarized

hardGates.passCondition: Photographs can create leads and corroborate visible facts but do not inherit identity, role, authorship, outcome, rights, consent, or publication approval.
failureExamples: A visually compelling image is treated as approved for publication

anchors.1: Important material can disappear or cannot be found again.
anchors.3: Most material is captured, but links or next actions are inconsistent.
anchors.5: Every fragment has a stable home, relationship path, and useful next action.

anchors.1: Claims rely on source aura or unsupported inference.
anchors.3: Sources are present but support boundaries remain broad.
anchors.5: Every consequential clause maps to evidence at the strongest defensible precision.

anchors.1: The system materially overstates, understates, or erases uncertainty.
anchors.3: The system is cautious but inconsistent about maturity or limits.
anchors.5: The system claims the full supported record and no more while preserving open and protected states.

anchors.1: Intake, sources, claims, inquiries, and projections compete or drift.
anchors.3: The objects exist but some relationships are implicit.
anchors.5: A future agent can trace every input through research, claim, and projection decisions.

anchors.1: The bank is an archive dump with no compositional value.
anchors.3: Material is accurate but difficult to select for an audience.
anchors.5: The bank offers deep, bounded material that can be composed clearly for changing goals.

anchors.1: Open questions have no research path.
anchors.3: Next steps exist but are generic.
anchors.5: Each unresolved item names the evidence, confirmation, or review needed to mature.

anchors.1: Photo work is disconnected from claims or unsafe.
anchors.5: Claims guide anchored retrieval and photo discoveries safely return as research leads.

fixtures.task: Receive a public URL that has not yet been closely read.
Receive Jamie's important role memory when public sources support only some actions.
mustNotDo: publish the full role claim as confirmed

fixtures.task: Develop a claim connecting Jamie's direct work to a successful collective policy campaign.
Retain a confirmed claim that is not needed by the current public composition.
mustNotDo: force it onto a public page
downgrade its factual status because it is unselected

fixtures.task: Encounter a consequential site claim whose source lineage is incomplete.
mustDo: preserve or soften wording according to current support

fixtures.task: A photo editor finds a potentially important scene not yet represented in the bank.
A campaign precedes later legislation and administrative change.
mustNotDo: erase the campaign from the record

fixtures.task: A complete surviving social surface and Jamie's bounded role memory arrive together for a collaborator-led project.
mustDo: scope completeness to the observed surface
separate Page identity from human authorship
keep mutable counters and outgoing tags within their evidence limits
mustNotDo: turn outgoing references into stakeholder engagement
turn counters into reach or impact
inflate naming support into sole authorship or ownership

rules: Both judges inspect the same graph snapshot independently.
Any failed hard gate blocks the iteration.
The generator cannot be a deciding judge.
Revise the smallest necessary record or relationship.
Keep the highest-scoring non-regressing graph, not the latest graph.

stopPolicy.successCondition: Both independent judges pass every hard gate, score at least 92, score every criterion at least 4, score calibration 5, and repeat the pass without regression.
stopPolicy.failureCondition: At iteration 8, preserve the strongest bounded graph and name unresolved criteria without claiming completion.
